route: Route: Route 36 south gate (55-57,25) -> gatehouse -> dig site -> four chamber doors and the research centre. Behind each chamber's back room a doorway leads to a Words Room, whose floor hole drops into the hall (B1F); the hall's stair comes back up in the middle of the dig site. Warps only: the donor's seams to Route 36 and Route 32 are not restored.
access: The donor reaches the west and south terraces only through Union Cave B1F, which this build does not have. Here the pond between the main site and the south terraces is crossed with Surf, two east-facing ledge tiles are repainted as plain ground so the south terraces are two-way, and the two Union Cave mouths lead to each other, which joins the west terrace to the rest.
events: Donor story is dropped: wandering Pokemon, Unown beams, lamps, both trainers, the visitors and both hidden items outside; the gatehouse staff; the sliding puzzles, their holes to B1F, item balls and statue text in the chambers; the fossil reviver in the research centre; the visitors, wandering Unown, fossils, GS Ball and wall text in the hall. The Route 32 gatehouse is not imported (Route 32 is not in this region); its door is made solid.
